findings.description: Missed PFL-AUTHORIT-02. Document shows Section C Consent Checkbox=False, Authorization Scope=N/A, Designated Individual Details=N/A (narrative explicitly states checkbox unchecked and scope omitted), yet Worker flagged no defect and listed only generic 'evaluated' checks.
Missed PFL-AUTHORIT-02 (vector sibling of 4c56). Section C Consent Checkbox=False and Authorization Scope=N/A, but Worker basis merely states the form was submitted with no defect detected.
Missed PFL-AUTHORIT-04. Family Member Consent=False with an accompanying adult spouse (Amit Sharma, age 39) and no separate IMM 5475; Worker listed generic checks and flagged nothing.

Missed PFL-AUTHORIT-04 and fabricated a field state: Worker basis asserts 'family_member_consent is evaluated as true' when the document clearly shows Family Member Consent=False with an accompanying adult spouse lacking separate consent. Invented fact contradicts the source.

Missed PFL-AUTHORIT-03 and fabricated a field state: Worker basis asserts 'authorization_scope populated without IMM 5476 scope mismatch' when Representative Authorization=True and scope grants full legal representation—an explicit IMM 5475/5476 mismatch. The vector sibling e5640785 was correctly caught, exposing inconsistent handling.
Correctly detected PFL-AUTHORIT-01 (Signature Date and Section C Date both N/A). Grounded reasoning tied to the exact undated fields.
Correctly detected PFL-AUTHORIT-03 form-scope mismatch (paid legal representative requires IMM 5476), with accurate field-grounded basis.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Make the consent/scope check deterministic and blocking: if section_c_consent_checkbox != true OR authorization_scope in {null, 'N/A', ''} OR designated_individual_details in {null, 'N/A', ''}, emit PFL-AUTHORIT-02 and verdict=defective. Both PFL-02 cases (4c56, ae84) were missed despite unambiguous False/N/A fields.

Add explicit family-consent rule: if family_member_consent == false OR (accompanying_spouse_full_name present AND no separate spouse_dependent_authorization/adult_dependant_signature), emit PFL-AUTHORIT-04 and verdict=defective. Both PFL-04 cases (77c8, edf3) were missed; edf3 was even reported as consent=true, contradicting the document.

Harden representative-scope detection: if representative_authorization == true OR designated_individual_role/authorization_scope contain 'representative', 'legal', 'conduct business', or 'submit', emit PFL-AUTHORIT-03 (requires IMM 5476). Case a70d (scanned) was missed while its vector sibling e5640785 was caught—remove reliance on rendering variant.

Require the Worker to transcribe each compliance-relevant field's literal value into basis[] (e.g., 'section_c_consent_checkbox=False') before rendering a verdict, and forbid asserting a field is 'true/populated/without mismatch' unless the transcribed value supports it. This prevents the fabricated 'consent=true' / 'no mismatch' assertions seen in edf3 and a70d.

rationale: Worker (gemini-3.6-flash) reliably catches signature-date defects (PFL-AUTHORIT-01: 3dac, 6a6e both caught) and correctly passes the two clean cases (856, e0b4) with grounded, PII-safe reasoning. However it systematically misses consent/scope defects (PFL-02: 4c56, ae84 both missed) and family-consent defects (PFL-04: 77c8, edf3 both missed), and inconsistently handles representative-scope mismatch (PFL-03: caught vector e5640785 but missed scanned a70d). Two misses (a70d, edf3) are aggravated by fabricated field states that directly contradict the document, sharply lowering grounding_accuracy there. Citations are consistent (uniform pr-pdi completeness-check anchor #067 with the official IMM 5475 quote) and scored 0.9 uniformly since the local-corpus source is plausible but unverifiable here. PII containment is perfect: all claims are generic policy statements, prose is empty, and applicant facts remain in basis[]. Blind compliance is intact—incorrect verdicts on missed cases confirm no ground-truth leakage. Net: 4 of 8 defective cases missed, indicating a recall gap concentrated in checkbox/scope/family fields rather than variant-specific OCR issues.
